GitHub master stays 6ad9ac3d1 and remains the default branch. Do not push, force-push, or change the default branch. Do not change gitlinks. execution_policy.implementation_provider_scope: Authorized Grok 4.7 development implementation via llm_router. Offline tests do not disable that provider process. Development permission is not consent to case-data egress.
execution_policy.product_inference: This plan does not change case inference, consent, or legal conclusions.
execution_policy.protected_state: The completed intake, mediator-grounding, GUI collaboration, GUI UX, repository-reorganization, repository-consolidation, module-depth, module-boundaries, module-seams, current-layout, owner-currency, cohesive-moves, and release-layout campaigns, both retained quarantines, submodule pins, and unrelated campaign processes stay untouched. completion_authority stays false. integrations/ipfs_accelerate/improvement_runner.py stays out of the task targets. The dead release-layout owner is not restarted by this plan.
execution_policy.upstream_checkout_policy: Use the pinned external checkouts recorded by HEAD. Do not float pins, recursively initialize submodules, or clone CommonCrawl.
required_evidence: A focused pytest module with positive checks and zero skips
Tracked runtime logs and crawl-cache binaries removed from the index
templates and static included by both package lists and present in a local wheel
Diagnostic helpers and optimizer report types defined in their new siblings
Example documentation matching the 26 tracked example scripts
execution_policy.qualification_scope: One focused pytest command per task. Do not run the full historical suite inside the 900-second task budget.
execution_policy.stop_semantics: A test that passes while a named body still lives in the owner, while a tracked scratch file remains, while the example count is still wrong, or while the wheel omits the named assets, is a failed task. Do not mark a task complete by hand.

findings.observation: git ls-files still tracks logs/UNCAUGHT_EXCEPTION.log, logs/app.log, and logs/test.log. .gitignore does not ignore logs/*.log. These are runtime logs, not product modules.
Three binary range files under datasets/CCINDEX_WARC_CACHE_DIR/ranges are tracked. They are a local crawl cache, not source. The published datasets gitlink stays put.

templates and static each contain __init__.py, HTML, and front-end assets. Neither setup.py nor pyproject.toml includes templates or static in the setuptools package find list. MANIFEST.in already names those asset globs. The wheel test in tests/test_cimp_rls_05.py does not require the assets.

denoiser.py is 5120 splitlines. Sixteen module-level diagnostic functions from _clip_public through publish_authorized_dependency_action, plus _DEPENDENCY_LANE_ALIASES, _DEPENDENCY_LANE_ACTIONS, and MAX_DEPENDENCY_ACTION_ATTEMPTS, form a closed helper block. ComplaintDenoiser starts at line 657 and stays. complaint_phases/interface.py already loads the public names from complaint_phases.denoiser and must not be edited.

optimizer.py is 4097 splitlines. OptimizationReport, WorkflowOptimizationBundle, UIUXOptimizationBundle, and UIOptimizationBundle are closed classes before Optimizer. The package lazy-loads those names from .optimizer. Optimizer stays.
examples/ contains 26 tracked Python scripts. docs/EXAMPLES.md says 22. DOCUMENTATION_INDEX.md says 23. The categories in EXAMPLES.md do not name the full tracked set.

patches/ contains 15 tracked JSON sidecars and 14 tracked patch files. Tracked JSON deletions trip the host source freeze, so this plan does not delete them. The readiness note records them as autopatch scratch, not a product package.
